https://asyncapi.pavelon.dev/schemas/sch.description: The Schema Object allows the definition of input and output data types. These types can be objects, but also primitives and arrays. The empty schema (which allows any instance to validate) MAY be represented by the boolean value true and a schema which allows no instance to validate MAY be represented by the boolean value false

See Composition and Inheritance for more details
